name: Add Drug References
action_description: Creates one drug_references record per medication entry in the extracted medications JSON, linked to the given phone call and contact

inputs.name: extracted_medications_json
inputs.label: Extracted Medications JSON
inputs.description: JSON array string of validated medication objects, each with name, name_normalized, name_type, status, form, dosage, excerpts, and extraction_notes

inputs.name: call_summary_name
inputs.label: Call Summary Name
inputs.description: Name of the current call summary record. Used to associate the medication reference record with the call summary.
